title: AppState change listener don't work when the app starts in react-native@0.59.x but work in react-native@0.56.0

labels.name: Resolution: Locked
labels.description: This issue was locked by the bot.

body:
```
...
class App extends Component {
    ...
    componentDidMount(){
        AppState.addEventListener('change', (nextAppState) => console.log(nextAppState));
    }
    componentWillUnmount() {
        AppState.removeEventListener('change');
    }
}
...
```
In `react-native@0.56.0`, I got the nextAppState is 'active' when the app starts, but in `react-native@0.59.9`, I got nothing.
